=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:139 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1` hides stderr diagnostics for the fetch retry loop.
  WHY: Transient network/auth warnings are lost, reducing observability during fetch retries.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:149-170 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` suppresses fetch failures, so LATEST can run against stale or incomplete remote tags.
  WHY: A partial fetch can lead to a later duplicate-tag push failure without an earlier diagnosis.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3627-3639 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/${VERSION}"` treats transport/auth/network errors as "tag missing".
  WHY: A transient failure can make the workflow skip an increment and proceed blindly without diagnostics.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3682-3685 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `STATE=$(_gh_retry gh api ... || echo "pending")` converts retry exhaustion into synthetic `pending`.
  WHY: Sustained GitHub API failure can bypass the CI gate and release without a confirmed source-branch status.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:70-133 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: On merge conflict, the workflow aborts back to a clean tree and creates the fallback PR from `origin/stable`, so the PR omits the attempted merge context/conflict hunks.
  WHY: Reviewers only see the raw stable-to-main diff and the conflict files list, and must reproduce the merge locally to understand the real conflict shape.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:147-165 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `set +e; gh pr create ...` with the benign-warning handling in the old path swallows non-benign PR creation failures.
  WHY: Auth/scope/rate-limit/repo-permission errors can prevent PR creation and the job can still appear successful.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:1-25,117-187 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: With `concurrency.group: forward-merge-stable-to-main` and `cancel-in-progress: false`, successive pushes to `stable` can create multiple fallback PRs for the same forward-merge target.
  WHY: Each run uses a unique `${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`, so the existing-PR check misses prior fallback PRs and operators can end up with overlapping PRs.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:74-88,119-133 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On merge conflict, `git merge --abort || true` resets HEAD to `origin/main` (the pre-merge state), discarding the merge attempt and the working tree's conflict state, and the fallback PR is then pushed from `origin/stable` directly.
  WHY: Reviewers see a clean stable-to-main diff with conflicts surfacing only when they attempt to merge the PR; the conflict files list is included in the PR body, but the actual conflict context is lost.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:1-25,117-187 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With `concurrency.group: forward-merge-stable-to-main` and `cancel-in-progress: false`, rapid successive pushes to `stable` produce serially-queued runs that can open a SECOND fallback PR from a different branch even though Run 1's PR already covers the same commit set.
  WHY: The "already exists" check only matches the same branch name, but each run uses a unique `${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`, so operators can end up with multiple PRs for overlapping commit sets.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:149-170 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` continues to suppress all fetch errors (network, auth, rate-limit, transport failures), even post-grep tolerance fix.
  WHY: LATEST and collision loop then run against potentially stale/missing remote tags; if fetch partially fails, the job can later fail on duplicate tag push without diagnosing tag-sync failure.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3627-3639 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/${VERSION}"` treats *all* non-zero exits as "tag missing", including transient transport/auth/network errors (no retry wrapper like _gh_retry).
  WHY: Ephemeral failure can skip increment or later fail on duplicate tag push; no early warning, so the workflow proceeds blindly.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3682-3685 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `|| echo "pending"` converts `_gh_retry` exhaustion (repeated 5xx/rate-limit/malformed response) to synthetic "pending", bypassing CI gate.
  WHY: Sustained GH API failure can let release cuts proceed without source-branch CI verification, violating the release safety invariant.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:70-113 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Merge conflict aborts and resets to `origin/stable`, and the fallback PR from a clean `origin/stable` lacks the attempted merge commit/conflict hunks.
  WHY: Manual reviewers see the raw stable→main diff, not resolution context (what conflicted, proposed merge state), which makes triage harder.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:147-165 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Loose `|| echo "::warning::"` swallows non-benign `gh pr create` failures (auth/scope outage, rate-limit, repo perms), succeeding the job silently.
  WHY: Propagation drops with no PR created and no alert, so stable fixes can be lost until manual detection.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
